methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this study conducted an online survey of 40 polling questions during the 50001 Ready Virtual In-Plant Training to identify the barriers and challenges of implementing ISO 50001-based energy management systems

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Mentions EnPI/EnB only incidentally: linear regression and energy baselines appear as a 50001 Ready Navigator task, as survey topics, and as an area where participants need more assistance, with no EnPI/EnB model identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). The paper presents a training program and a survey of ISO 50001-based EnMS implementation barriers, i.e., a framework/training study without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: it discusses findings from the responses to 40 live polling questions about the status of the 25 tasks of the 50001 Ready Navigator

stage1.notes: Survey/training-outcomes study of the DOE Better Plants 50001 Ready VINPLT (28 companies). Linear-regression EnPI mentioned only as a recommended method and survey topic, not modelled or characterised.
